name: 35mm Documentary Street Photography
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Compose candid 35mm documentary frames: include authentic environmental clutter (wet pavement, crosswalk paint, shop awnings, bicycles, weathered brick), off-guard natural posture, and 35mm `f/2.8` balanced depth.
negative_prompt_patch: plastic airbrushed skin, studio backdrop, stiff fashion pose

name: 85mm f/1.4 Editorial Portrait
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor portraits on `85mm prime lens, f/1.4, shallow depth of field`, natural iris catchlights, micro-skin pores, asymmetric collar/fabric drape, and gentle background bokeh falloff.
negative_prompt_patch: waxy skin, over-smoothed face, symmetrical mannequin stare

name: 50mm Standard Human Perspective
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep perspective distortion neutral via `50mm prime lens, f/2.0`, natural eye-level horizon, candid posture, and truthful daylight falloff matching human vision.

name: 100mm Macro Micro-Texture
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify `100mm macro lens, razor-thin focal plane`, tactile surface relief (brushed brass micro-scratches, weave fibers, water surface tension), and soft specular highlights.

name: Medium-Format Tonal Roll-Off
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use medium-format optical character: `80mm f/2.8 medium format sensor, subtle highlight roll-off, rich shadow gradations, razor micro-contrast`, completely free of harsh digital oversharpening halos.
negative_prompt_patch: hdr halo, oversaturated cartoon, cheap smartphone sharpening

name: Kodak Portra 400 Film Character
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Infuse natural analog film rendering: `Kodak Portra 400 film stock, subtle organic silver halide grain, gentle green-tinted shadows, creamy highlight halation, truthful skin warmth`.

name: CineStill 800T Neon Night Film
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Apply `CineStill 800T tungsten balanced film`: cool cyan ambient shadows paired with warm sodium/tungsten shop windows and crisp red halation rims around bright bulbs.

name: Ilford HP5 Monochrome Silver
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Compose high-discipline monochrome: `Ilford HP5 Plus 400, rich Zone III–VII silver tones, sculptural side contrast, gritty silver grain, crisp highlight separation`.

name: Architectural Perspective Control
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify `24mm tilt-shift architectural lens, perfectly plumb verticals`, honest concrete/stone/glass material physics, interior light warmth balancing sky exposure.

name: Commercial Product & Glass Studio
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Define clean strip-softbox gradient reflections along bevels and glass curves, matte pedestal surface, crisp edge rim, and uncluttered negative space.

name: Editorial Food & Culinary Depth
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Frame at 45° hero angle with diffused window backlight revealing rising steam, glistening oil/sauce speculars, rustic ceramic glaze, and shallow `85mm f/2.0` background falloff.

name: Editorial Fashion & Fabric Physics
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Emphasize garment construction: wool weight, silk specular crease, leather patina, asymmetry in stance, intentional wind lift, and clean editorial color harmony.

name: Rolling Rig Automotive Stills
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep exact wheel symmetry, ground contact shadow weight, coherent horizon reflections across body panels, spinning spoke motion blur via rolling shutter rig, and disciplined 35mm three-quarter framing.

name: Hyperfocal Alpine & Coastal Vistas
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Compose with `24mm wide angle, f/11 hyperfocal crispness` spanning textured foreground rock/snow, middle-ground mist separation, and sunlit serrated mountain peaks.

name: Top-Down Drone Terrain Geometry
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Frame straight-down nadir or 60° oblique drone altitude highlighting graphic terrain patterns, winding road switchbacks, wave foam striations, and crisp solar shadows.

name: Grounded Anatomy & Hand Mechanics
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep hands occupied naturally (gripping rail, resting in coat pocket, holding hilt or mug), specify grounded foot weight distribution and spine curve so limbs never float awkwardly.
negative_prompt_patch: extra fingers, fused fingers, mutated hands, floating feet

name: Subsurface Skin & Eye Realism
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Request `subtle skin pores, fine freckles, natural subsurface light scattering around ears/knuckles, moist corneal catchlight, stray flyaway hairs` so faces read photographic rather than rendered.
negative_prompt_patch: plastic skin, porcelain doll, 3d cgi render, smooth airbrush

name: Rain-Slick Asphalt & Puddle Mirror
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Render damp granite cobblestones and oily asphalt reflections splitting warm storefront lights across ripples, wet shoulder fabric darkening, and airborne rain mist.

name: Architectural Interior Balance
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Balance cool daylight pouring from tall windows against warm interior oak/linen bounce and glowing brass reading lamps; show tactile wood grain and realistic shadow grounding under furniture.

name: Submerged Caustics & Water Clarity
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe volumetric turquoise water attenuation by depth, undulating solar caustic ribbons dancing over stone/sand, fine floating plankton particles, and wet hair buoyancy.

name: Theatrical Feature Anime Cel
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Combine `source_anime, theatrical anime film keyframe, clean variable-weight lineart, painted watercolor background plates, crisp multi-step cel shading and luminous rim highlights`.

name: Industrial Cyberpunk Materiality
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Ground sci-fi imagery in worn utility: scuffed anodized metal, bundled conduit cables, condensation vents, backlit kanji/hangul signage, and optical lens grime rather than sterile neon grids.

name: Classical Dark Fantasy Realism
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Anchor fantasy in tangible craft: hammered steel dents, mud-caked cloaks, woven mail rings, damp mossy stonework, storm overcast, and monumental environmental scale.

name: Hard-Surface Spacecraft & Mechs
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Emphasize NASA/industrial realism: thermal gold Kapton foil, micro-panel seams, stenciled safety markings, harsh unfiltered directional solar key in vacuum, and clean perspective lines.
